function.description: Get bugs affecting the network device
function.name: api_getBugsAffectingTheNetworkDevice

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

order.description: Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response. Available values : asc, desc. Default value is asc.

severity.description: Return network bugs with this severity. Available values : CATASTROPHIC, SEVERE, MODERATE.

sortBy.description: A property within the response to sort by.

affectedVersions.description: Versions that are affected by the network bug

deviceCount.description: Number of devices which are vulnerable to this network bug

hasWorkaround.description: Indicates if the network bug has a workaround

integratedReleases.description: Versions that have the fix for the network bug

publicationUrl.description: Url for getting network bug details on cisco website

severity.description: 'CATASTROPHIC' - Reasonably common circumstances cause the entire system to fail, or a major subsystem to stop working. 'SEVERE' - Important functions are unusable. 'MODERATE' - Failures occur in unusual circumstances, or minor features do not work at all.

workaround.description: Workaround if any that exists for the network bug
